title: Length-of-Stay Day Rates for Self-Pay Observation (Hospital Account (Encounter Billing))
content:
A longer self-pay observation stay on a Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account lowers the observation day rate. The observation hours are the total units of the account's observation-hour charge lines (revenue code 0762).

**Clause.** Observation hours of at least 48 add -150.00 dollars per day to the observation day rate (lowering it by 150.00 for each day); observation hours of at least 24 but below 48 add -50.00 dollars per day (lowering it by 50.00); fewer hours add none.

| Observation hours | Change to the observation day rate, per day |
|---|---|
| 48 or more | -150.00 added (lower by 150.00) |
| 24 through 47 | -50.00 added (lower by 50.00) |
| fewer than 24 | none |

*Edges (hypothetical stays).* 48 hours: 150.00 lower per day; 47 hours: 50.00 lower; 24 hours: 50.00 lower; 23 hours: unchanged.
